scope: Assess whether euro-area labour mediation can be reconstructed point-in-time using negotiated wages and services/domestic inflation without revised-history substitution.

services_inflation.official_source: Eurostat HICP services / ECB HICP publication calendar
services_inflation.release_structure: flash estimate near month-end plus final release around mid-next-month
services_inflation.event_time_policy: Use observation only after the relevant official release timestamp/date; prefer flash estimate when historically available, then final release only from its publication time onward.
services_inflation.revision_policy: No ex-post revised series may be backfilled into earlier checkpoints.
services_inflation.assessment: A services-inflation PIT bridge is structurally feasible because release timing is public and regular.

negotiated_wages.official_source: ECB Indicator of Negotiated Wages (INW/legacy STS series)

first_release_evidence.evidence_type: ECB dated publication citing latest Q1 2024 negotiated-wage release

negotiated_wages.risk: Current long historical series may contain revised/backfilled observations; it cannot be used directly for PIT checkpoints without a certified first-release/vintage availability table.
negotiated_wages.activation_condition: For each quarter used in backtest, certify the first public release date/time and the value observable at that release. If this cannot be established, keep the quarter WITHHELD.
negotiated_wages.assessment: Structurally promising but not yet PIT-eligible.

next_steps: Materialize euro-area HICP services PIT release table from official flash/final release calendar.
Build a quarterly negotiated-wages vintage table using dated ECB releases and archive evidence.
Require exact first-known date/time and first-known value for every eligible negotiated-wage observation.
Only after both bridges are certified, rerun EUR direct-labour versus mediated-labour OOS tests without changing weights or thresholds.
